canonical_statement: Let M be a connected finite-dimensional boundaryless smooth Riemannian manifold whose induced Riemannian emetric is complete. For every p and q in M there is a smooth path from p to q on [0,1] such that every ordered subsegment has length equal to the Riemannian extended distance of its endpoints.
